newsitem.title: USA: Advanta seeks relief from cease and desist efforts.
newsitem.headline: Advanta seeks relief from cease and desist efforts.

text.p: Advanta Corp said it sought legal relief from "cease and desist" letters it received from both Visa U.S.A. and MasterCard International that seek to stop Advanta from continuing its "Rewards Accelerator" program with American Express.
Advanta's "Rewards Accelerator" MasterCard or Visa card program launched earlier this month allows cardholders to earn points redeemable in American Express' "Membership Rewards" program.

"Before launching the Rewards Accelerator card, we studied both associations rules very carefully and were confident that our product was in complete compliance and that we were acting within our legal rights to market it," said Alex "Pete" Hart, Advanta's chief executive officer.
"We can only see the associations' moves as anti-competitive, and we are seeking relief on behalf of all consumers who want the freedom to have a system of complementary cards," Hart said.
Visa amended its regulations on November 25, two and a half weeks after the Rewards Accelerator card was launched, Advanta said.
Visa claims that the newly amended regulation prohibits any member from tying a Visa product to any product issued by a competitor such as American Express.
In the case of MasterCard, Advanta said it was put on notice on Nov 27 that MasterCard also viewed Advanta's Rewards Accelerator program as a violation of its rules.
